# Priceline Pharmacy Pacific Fair

Last updated: 8 October 2026

> An independently owned Priceline Pharmacy franchise store on the ground floor of Pacific Fair Shopping Centre, Broadbeach, open 7 days. Scripts ready in minutes, walk-in vaccinations, pharmacist consultations and beauty advice, with the GPs of Help Medical, an independent general practice located inside our store.

## Key facts
- Vaccinations (ages 5 and over): Free for eligible people under the National Immunisation Program, with no service fee.
- Medication packing (Webster packs): Free for concession and health care card holders. $5 a week otherwise.
- Ear piercing (ages 8 and over): $65 including earrings and aftercare.
- Passport and visa photos: $25. About 10 minutes.
- Contraception consultation: $35 consultation. Your contraception is charged separately; many types are on the PBS. Please call first; trained pharmacists are usually available Monday to Friday.
- UTI treatment: No booking needed. Walk in. For women aged 18 to 65 with symptoms of an uncomplicated bladder infection.
- Parking: 4 hours of free parking at Pacific Fair each day.
- Delivery: Everyday health, beauty and wellbeing products delivered through Uber Eats. Prescription medicines can’t be delivered this way.
- Late night: open until 9pm on Thursdays.
- Help Medical: An independent general practice located inside our store, with a QML Pathology collection room open Monday to Friday, 8:00am – 1:00pm. Closed weekends.

- Address: Shop 81, Pacific Fair Shopping Centre, Hooker Blvd, Broadbeach QLD 4218
- Phone: (07) 5592 2099
- Email: info@pricelinepf.com.au (general), pharmacy@pricelinepf.com.au (prescriptions)
- Opening hours: Monday to Wednesday: 8am – 5:30pm; Thursday: 8am – 9pm; Friday: 8am – 5:30pm; Saturday: 9am – 5:30pm; Sunday: 9:30am – 4:30pm. Public holiday hours are published on the Google Business Profile.
- Owner and pharmacist: Jason Markey, BPharmSci, MPharm. Independently owned Priceline Pharmacy franchise store, opened 2009.
- Book online: https://app.medadvisor.com.au/Network/PRICELINEPHARMACYPACIFICFAIR
- Help Medical (independent general practice inside the store): (07) 5619 3818, website https://helpmedical.au/, online bookings https://www.hotdoc.com.au/medical-centres/broadbeach-QLD-4218/help-medical/doctors. Hours: Monday to Wednesday: 8am – 5pm; Thursday: 8am – 9pm; Friday: 8am – 5pm; Saturday and Sunday: 9:30am – 4pm.
- QML Pathology collection inside Help Medical: Monday to Friday, 8:00am – 1:00pm. Closed weekends.

## Services
- [Prescriptions & eScripts](https://pricelinepacificfair.com.au/prescriptions/): Paper scripts, eScripts, Active Script Lists, hospital, interstate and vet scripts. Send yours ahead.
- [Vaccinations](https://pricelinepacificfair.com.au/vaccination-information/): Flu, COVID-19, whooping cough, shingles, RSV, pneumococcal and travel vaccines. Walk in or book.
- [Flu vaccination](https://pricelinepacificfair.com.au/flu-vaccination/): Yearly flu shot, walk in or book. Free for eligible people under the NIP.
- [Travel health & vaccinations](https://pricelinepacificfair.com.au/travel-health/): Travel vaccines, a travel health kit and advice on taking your medicines overseas.
- [Medication packing (Webster packs)](https://pricelinepacificfair.com.au/medication-packing/): Your medicines sorted by day and time in weekly blister packs.
- [Medication reviews](https://pricelinepacificfair.com.au/medication-reviews/): A free one-on-one check of all your medicines with a pharmacist.
- [Health Station checks](https://pricelinepacificfair.com.au/health-station/): Free blood pressure, weight, BMI and type 2 diabetes risk checks.
- [Diabetes & NDSS](https://pricelinepacificfair.com.au/national-diabetes-services-scheme/): NDSS access point for subsidised diabetes supplies, with pharmacist advice.
- [Weight management support](https://pricelinepacificfair.com.au/weight-loss-counselling-and-advice/): Free, private one-on-one support from our pharmacists.
- [Delivery](https://pricelinepacificfair.com.au/delivery/): Health and beauty products delivered across the Gold Coast via Uber Eats.
- [Click & Collect](https://pricelinepacificfair.com.au/click-and-collect/): Shop online at priceline.com.au and collect from us, usually within 15 minutes.
- [Priceline Pharmacy app](https://pricelinepacificfair.com.au/download-the-priceline-app/): Order scripts ahead, get reminders and manage your Sister Club rewards.
- [Contraception consultations](https://pricelinepacificfair.com.au/hormonal-contraceptive-pill/): Start, change or continue the pill, ring or injection with a trained pharmacist. $35.
- [UTI treatment](https://pricelinepacificfair.com.au/uti-treatment/): Assessment and treatment for uncomplicated bladder infections, women 18 to 65.
- [Emergency contraception](https://pricelinepacificfair.com.au/emergency-contraception/): Available from our pharmacists without an appointment, in private.
- [Women's health](https://pricelinepacificfair.com.au/womens-health/): Contraception, UTI treatment, pregnancy, periods and menopause support from our pharmacists.
- [Quit smoking](https://pricelinepacificfair.com.au/quit-smoking/): Help choosing quit options, making a plan and staying on track.
- [Passport & visa photos](https://pricelinepacificfair.com.au/passport-photos/): Australian and overseas passport and visa photos while you wait. $25.
- [Ear piercing](https://pricelinepacificfair.com.au/ear-piercings/): Hygienic single-use system, earrings and aftercare included. $65, walk in.
- [Skincare & self-tan](https://pricelinepacificfair.com.au/skincare-tanning/): Free advice from trained beauty advisors, and brands that suit the Gold Coast climate.
- [Makeup & fragrance](https://pricelinepacificfair.com.au/beauty-fragrance/): Makeup, fragrance, dental care and men’s grooming with help from our beauty team.
- [Vitamins & supplements](https://pricelinepacificfair.com.au/vitamins-supplements/): Everyday and practitioner ranges, checked against your medicines by a pharmacist.
- [Metagenics](https://pricelinepacificfair.com.au/metagenics-vitamins/): Practitioner-range supplements in stock or ordered in, with pharmacist advice.
- [Help Medical GPs](https://pricelinepacificfair.com.au/help-medical/): An independent general practice located inside our store. Bulk billing for eligible patients, QML pathology collection, walk-ins welcome.

## Health advice articles (pharmacist-reviewed)
- [Acne treatment at the pharmacy: what actually helps](https://pricelinepacificfair.com.au/acne-treatment-pharmacy/): Acne treatment from the pharmacy: what helps, how long it takes and when to see a GP. Pharmacist tips on sunscreen and skincare for humid Gold Coast days.
- [Athlete’s foot treatment: how to clear it for good](https://pricelinepacificfair.com.au/athletes-foot-treatment/): Athlete's foot treatment: pharmacy antifungal options, how long to use them and when to see a GP. Tips for humid Gold Coast summers, pools and gym showers.
- [Bluebottle sting treatment: what to do (and what not to do)](https://pricelinepacificfair.com.au/bluebottle-sting-treatment/): Stung by a bluebottle on the Gold Coast? Step-by-step first aid from Australian guidelines, myths to ignore (vinegar, urine) and when to call 000.
- [Common cold remedies: myths, facts and what helps](https://pricelinepacificfair.com.au/common-cold-remedies/): Common cold remedies that ease symptoms, cold vs flu, why antibiotics don't help, and safe options for kids. Advice from our Pacific Fair pharmacists.
- [Constipation relief: a pharmacist’s checklist](https://pricelinepacificfair.com.au/constipation-relief/): Constipation relief that works: fibre, fluids, toilet position and laxative types explained, plus tips for Gold Coast holidays and when to see a GP.
- [Dandruff treatment: your questions answered](https://pricelinepacificfair.com.au/dandruff-treatment/): Dandruff treatment explained: causes, medicated shampoos, home tips and when to see a GP. Handy advice for Gold Coast swimmers who wash their hair often.
- [Dry skin remedies: a pharmacist’s checklist](https://pricelinepacificfair.com.au/dry-skin-remedies/): Dry skin remedies that work: shower habits, choosing a moisturiser and when to see a GP. Tips for skin dried out by Gold Coast sun, salt water and air-con.
- [Haemorrhoids treatment: myths, facts and home care](https://pricelinepacificfair.com.au/haemorrhoids-treatment/): Haemorrhoids treatment at home and from the pharmacy, why drinking water matters in Gold Coast heat, and when any bleeding means you should see a GP.
- [Headache relief: your questions answered](https://pricelinepacificfair.com.au/headache-relief/): Headache relief explained: tension-type triggers like Gold Coast heat and dehydration, safe pain relief, medication-overuse headache and when to call 000.
- [Heartburn relief and GORD: what actually helps](https://pricelinepacificfair.com.au/heartburn-relief/): Heartburn relief from our Broadbeach pharmacists: common triggers, eating and sleep tips, pharmacy reflux medicines, and when chest pain means call 000.
- [How to treat a cut or scrape: step-by-step first aid](https://pricelinepacificfair.com.au/how-to-treat-a-cut/): How to treat a cut or scrape: stop bleeding, clean, cover and spot infection. Plus tetanus advice and red flags for Gold Coast beach and holiday injuries.
- [Migraine relief: what to do when an attack starts](https://pricelinepacificfair.com.au/migraine-relief/): Migraine relief step by step: spot the warning signs, act early, know your triggers like Gold Coast storms and glare, and when a headache means call 000.
- [Mouth ulcer treatment: home care and when to worry](https://pricelinepacificfair.com.au/mouth-ulcer-treatment/): Mouth ulcer treatment: saltwater rinses, soft foods (skip the salty beach chips), pharmacy gels, and when an ulcer needs a Gold Coast dentist or GP.
- [Nail fungus treatment: myths, facts and what works](https://pricelinepacificfair.com.au/nail-fungus-treatment/): Nail fungus treatment myths vs facts: pharmacy nail lacquers, when you need a GP and why it takes months. Foot tips for humid Gold Coast summers and pools.
- [Scabies treatment in Australia: your questions answered](https://pricelinepacificfair.com.au/scabies-treatment-australia/): Scabies treatment in Australia: pharmacy and GP options, treating your whole household, washing bedding, and advice for Gold Coast share houses.
- [Sprain vs strain: what’s the difference and what to do](https://pricelinepacificfair.com.au/sprain-vs-strain/): Sprain vs strain explained, with RICE and No HARM first aid for ankles rolled on Gold Coast sand, plus the red flags that mean a GP visit or X-ray.
- [Sun safety on the Gold Coast: why UV is a year-round job](https://pricelinepacificfair.com.au/sun-safety-gold-coast/): Gold Coast UV hits 3+ every day, even in winter. Simple sun safety for beach days, the school run and car parks, plus when to get a spot checked by a GP.
- [Sunburn treatment: what to do after too much sun](https://pricelinepacificfair.com.au/sunburn-treatment/): Sunburn treatment step by step: cool, soothe and protect burnt skin, and know when to see a GP. Pharmacist tips for Gold Coast beach days and holidays.
- [Trouble sleeping: tips from your local pharmacist](https://pricelinepacificfair.com.au/trouble-sleeping-tips/): Trouble sleeping tips for hot, humid Gold Coast nights: routines, caffeine timing, when to see a GP and how our Pacific Fair pharmacists can help.
